content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler pudding is a gentle toddler dessert made from selected fruits and berries, without added sugar or artificial flavors. Suitable for children from 6 months old, it is easy to digest and helps develop taste preferences.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Produced in small batches to ensure consistent quality.
Contains only 100 % natural ingredients, free from gluten and lactose.
Each pack is made from fruits grown in environmentally clean regions.
The product meets strict safety controls and complies with international infant nutrition standards.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: The pudding provides vitamin C, vitamin A and B‑complex vitamins that support immunity and visual development in toddlers.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy bowel function and helps establish a balanced gut microbiome.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Absence of added sugar helps avoid rapid blood‑glucose spikes.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Its smooth texture and lack of heavy proteins make it an ideal first complementary food.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Minerals such as potassium and magnesium aid muscle and nervous system development.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to specific fruits should consult a pediatrician before introducing the product.

items.title: Age restrictions
items.content: Not recommended for infants under 6 months without pediatric guidance.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pudding straight from the pack, stir into baby cereal or yogurt, or use as a filling for toddler pancakes. Warm gently to a comfortable temperature if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened pack in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and use within 2 days.

content.title: About
content.content: Papaya juice 100% is a completely natural beverage made from ripe papaya without added sugar, preservatives, or flavorings. It has a sweet, slightly tropical taste and a bright orange color.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Papaya originates from Central and South America but is now cultivated in tropical regions worldwide.
The juice is rich in carotenoids, which give it its characteristic orange hue.
In traditional medicine papaya has been used to aid digestion thanks to the enzyme papain.
Papaya contains more vitamin C per 100 g than an orange.
Papaya juice is often used in smoothies, cocktails, and meat marinades.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains vitamin A and carotenoids
items.content: Carotenoids help maintain healthy vision and skin.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The enzyme papain helps break down proteins, promoting better digestion.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium regulates fluid balance and supports heart function.

items.title: Low‑calorie drink
items.content: Papaya juice is low in calories, making it a good choice for weight‑conscious consumers.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to papaya.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, natural sugars may affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Possible interactions
items.content: Papain can enhance the effect of certain medications, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Papaya juice can be enjoyed chilled, used in smoothies, cocktails, marinades, or as a base for fruit desserts. Adding a splash of lime can brighten the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store papaya juice in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in a sealed container. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Discard if it develops a fermented smell or changes color.
